#Section 1: Setup and Data Loading
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SECTION 1: SETUP AND DATA LOADING (Optimized & Robust)
# ============================================================================

# ---- Clean environment ----
rm(list = ls())
gc()

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("   CAR LOAN DEFAULT PREDICTION - WORKFLOW   \n")
cat("   Version 2.0   |   9 Features + Tenure\n")
cat("============================================\n\n")

# ---- Required packages ----
required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse", "caret", "randomForest", "xgboost",
  "pROC", "gridExtra", "knitr", "kableExtra",
  "car", "ranger", "Matrix", "data.table"
)

cat("Checking & installing required packages...\n\n")

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    cat(sprintf("Installing package: %s ...\n", pkg))
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE))
  } else {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE))
  }
}

cat("\n✓ All packages loaded successfully\n\n")

# ---- Set working directory safely ----

data_path <- "C:/Users/Along/Desktop/mlbd/Car_Loan _Project/04 Opitimization Model/9"

if (!dir.exists(data_path)) {
  stop(sprintf("ERROR: Directory not found:\n%s\nPlease check path.", data_path))
} else {
  setwd(data_path)
  cat(sprintf("Working directory set to:\n%s\n\n", normalizePath(data_path)))
}

# ---- Load data ----
cat("Loading dataset: car_loan_data_with_tenure.csv ...\n")

# Fix encoding issues for Chinese paths
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL","English")

data_raw <- tryCatch(
  read.csv("car_loan_data_with_tenure.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fileEncoding="UTF-8-BOM"),
  error = function(e) {
    stop("ERROR: File could not be read.\nCheck encoding or filename.\nMessage: ", e$message)
  }
)

cat(sprintf("✓ Data loaded: %d rows × %d columns\n\n", nrow(data_raw), ncol(data_raw)))

# ---- Basic Data Diagnostics ----
cat("Checking dataset integrity...\n")

if (nrow(data_raw) == 0) stop("ERROR: dataset has 0 rows.")
if (ncol(data_raw) == 0) stop("ERROR: dataset has 0 columns.")

# Detect duplicated columns
if (any(duplicated(names(data_raw)))) {
  warning("Duplicated column names detected. Showing duplicates:")
  print(names(data_raw)[duplicated(names(data_raw))])
}

# Check NA summary
na_stats <- colSums(is.na(data_raw))
cat("\nMissing values per column:\n")
print(na_stats)

# ---- Show dataset structure ----
cat("\nDataset structure:\n")
str(data_raw)

cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")
print(head(data_raw, 5))

cat("\n✓ SECTION 1 COMPLETE\n\n")
```

Section 2: Data Cleaning
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SECTION 2: DATA CLEANING
# ============================================================================

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
cat("SECTION 2: DATA CLEANING\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n", sep = "")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.1 Handle size_of_downpayment (convert percentage to decimal)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=== 2.1 Processing size_of_downpayment ===\n\n")
cat("Original format:\n")
print(head(data_raw$size_of_downpayment, 10))

# Convert percentage string to numeric decimal
data_raw$size_of_downpayment <- as.numeric(
  gsub("%", "", data_raw$size_of_downpayment)
) / 100

cat("\nConverted format:\n")
print(head(data_raw$size_of_downpayment, 10))
cat(sprintf("\n✓ Conversion complete\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Range: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", 
            min(data_raw$size_of_downpayment, na.rm = TRUE),
            max(data_raw$size_of_downpayment, na.rm = TRUE)))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.2 Handle repaid_loan_on_prev_car (convert to binary)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== 2.2 Processing repaid_loan_on_prev_car ===\n\n")
cat("Original values:\n")
print(table(data_raw$repaid_loan_on_prev_car))

# Convert TRUE/FALSE to 1/0
data_raw$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- as.integer(
  as.logical(data_raw$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)
)

cat("\nConverted values:\n")
print(table(data_raw$repaid_loan_on_prev_car))
cat("\n✓ Conversion complete\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.3 Handle target variable (repaid)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== 2.3 Processing target variable ===\n\n")
cat("Original distribution:\n")
print(table(data_raw$repaid))

# Keep as numeric for now (will convert to factor later)
cat("\nTarget variable distribution:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Not Repaid (0): %d (%.2f%%)\n", 
            sum(data_raw$repaid == 0),
            mean(data_raw$repaid == 0) * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Repaid (1): %d (%.2f%%)\n", 
            sum(data_raw$repaid == 1),
            mean(data_raw$repaid == 1) * 100))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.4 Check for missing values
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== 2.4 Missing Values Check ===\n\n")
missing_counts <- colSums(is.na(data_raw))
total_missing <- sum(missing_counts)

if(total_missing > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("⚠ Found %d missing values:\n", total_missing))
  missing_summary <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(missing_counts[missing_counts > 0]),
    Missing_Count = missing_counts[missing_counts > 0],
    Percentage = round(missing_counts[missing_counts > 0] / nrow(data_raw) * 100, 2)
  )
  print(missing_summary, row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Remove rows with missing values
  data_clean <- data_raw %>% drop_na()
  cat(sprintf("\n✓ Removed %d rows with missing values\n", 
              nrow(data_raw) - nrow(data_clean)))
} else {
  cat("✓ No missing values detected\n")
  data_clean <- data_raw
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.5 Final validation
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== 2.5 Final Validation ===\n\n")
cat("Data types:\n")
cat(sprintf("  car_value: %s\n", class(data_clean$car_value)))
cat(sprintf("  salary_range: %s\n", class(data_clean$salary_range)))
cat(sprintf("  debt_to_income_ratio: %s\n", class(data_clean$debt_to_income_ratio)))
cat(sprintf("  loan_length: %s\n", class(data_clean$loan_length)))
cat(sprintf("  repaid_loan_on_prev_car: %s\n", class(data_clean$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)))
cat(sprintf("  size_of_downpayment: %s\n", class(data_clean$size_of_downpayment)))
cat(sprintf("  driver_tenure: %s\n", class(data_clean$driver_tenure)))

cat("\nFinal dataset:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Rows: %d\n", nrow(data_clean)))
cat(sprintf("  Columns: %d\n", ncol(data_clean)))

cat("\n✓ SECTION 2 COMPLETE\n\n")
```

Section 3: Feature Engineering
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SECTION 3: FEATURE ENGINEERING (9 FEATURES)
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
cat("SECTION 3: FEATURE ENGINEERING\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n", sep = "")

# Safety check
if(!exists("data_clean")) {
  stop("'data_clean' not found. Please complete SECTION 2 first.")
}

df <- data_clean

# Harmonize column naming: prefer salary_range
if("salary_level" %in% names(df) && !"salary_range" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- df %>% rename(salary_range = salary_level)
}

if(all(c("salary_level", "salary_range") %in% names(df))) {
  df <- df %>% rename(salary_level_raw = salary_level)
}

# Prepare global fallback for estimated monthly income
salary_map_vec <- case_when(
  df$salary_range %in% c("1", "low", "Low") ~ 2500,
  df$salary_range %in% c("2", "med", "Med", "2.0", "2") ~ 4000,
  df$salary_range %in% c("3", "high", "High", "3") ~ 6000,
  df$salary_range %in% c("4", "4.0") ~ 10000,
  TRUE ~ NA_real_
)

global_median_income <- suppressWarnings(median(salary_map_vec, na.rm = TRUE))

if(is.na(global_median_income)) {
  global_median_income <- 4000
  message("WARNING: No salary mapping available, using fallback global_median_income = ", 
          global_median_income)
}

# Derive engineered features
data_features <- df %>%
  mutate(
    salary_chr = if("salary_range" %in% names(.)) as.character(salary_range) else rep(NA_character_, n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1) Estimated monthly income (mapping then fallback to global median)
    estimated_monthly_income = case_when(
      salary_chr %in% c("1", "low", "Low") ~ 2500,
      salary_chr %in% c("2", "med", "Med", "2.0", "2") ~ 4000,
      salary_chr %in% c("3", "high", "High", "3") ~ 6000,
      salary_chr %in% c("4", "4.0") ~ 10000,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    estimated_monthly_income = ifelse(
      is.na(estimated_monthly_income), 
      global_median_income, 
      estimated_monthly_income
    ),
    
    # 2) Loan amount = car_value × (1 − down-payment ratio)
    car_value_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(car_value)))),
    downpay_ratio_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(size_of_downpayment)),
    downpay_ratio = ifelse(is.na(downpay_ratio_raw), 0, downpay_ratio_raw),
    loan_amount = pmax(0, coalesce(car_value_num, 0) * (1 - downpay_ratio)),
    
    # 3) Monthly payment (annuity formula)
    loan_length_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(loan_length)),
    loan_length_num = ifelse(is.na(loan_length_num) | loan_length_num <= 0, NA_real_, loan_length_num),
    ann_rate_annual = 0.08,
    monthly_rate = ann_rate_annual / 12,
    monthly_payment_annuity = ifelse(
      !is.na(loan_length_num) & loan_length_num > 0,
      (loan_amount * monthly_rate * (1 + monthly_rate) ^ loan_length_num) / 
        ((1 + monthly_rate) ^ loan_length_num - 1),
      NA_real_
    ),
    monthly_payment = monthly_payment_annuity,
    monthly_payment = ifelse(
      is.na(monthly_payment) | !is.finite(monthly_payment) | monthly_payment <= 0,
      ifelse(!is.na(loan_length_num) & loan_length_num > 0, 
             loan_amount / loan_length_num, 
             NA_real_),
      monthly_payment
    ),
    
    # 4) payment_to_income (robust)
    payment_to_income = NA_real_,
    payment_to_income = ifelse(
      is.finite(monthly_payment) & !is.na(monthly_payment) &
        is.finite(estimated_monthly_income) & estimated_monthly_income > 0,
      monthly_payment / estimated_monthly_income,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Diagnostic flag to help trace why payment_to_income missing
    payment_to_income_flag = case_when(
      is.na(payment_to_income) & (is.na(monthly_payment) | !is.finite(monthly_payment)) ~ "no_payment",
      is.na(payment_to_income) & (is.na(estimated_monthly_income) | estimated_monthly_income <= 0) ~ "no_income",
      is.na(payment_to_income) ~ "other",
      TRUE ~ "ok"
    ),
    
    # 5) downpayment_amount
    downpayment_amount = coalesce(car_value_num, 0) * downpay_ratio,
    
    # 6) loan_to_value_ratio (LTV)
    loan_to_value_ratio = ifelse(
      coalesce(car_value_num, 0) > 0,
      loan_amount / coalesce(car_value_num, 1), 
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # 7) debt_to_income_ratio (keep existing if present)
    debt_to_income_ratio = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(debt_to_income_ratio)),
    debt_to_income_ratio = ifelse(
      is.na(debt_to_income_ratio),
      payment_to_income, 
      debt_to_income_ratio
    ),
    
    # 8) repaid_loan_on_prev_car → numeric 0/1
    repaid_loan_on_prev_car = case_when(
      is.na(repaid_loan_on_prev_car) ~ 0,
      is.logical(repaid_loan_on_prev_car) ~ as.numeric(repaid_loan_on_prev_car),
      TRUE ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(repaid_loan_on_prev_car)))
    ),
    repaid_loan_on_prev_car = ifelse(is.na(repaid_loan_on_prev_car), 0, repaid_loan_on_prev_car),
    
    # 9) driver_tenure → numeric (NA → 0 conservative handling)
    driver_tenure = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(driver_tenure)),
    driver_tenure = ifelse(is.na(driver_tenure), 0, driver_tenure)
  ) %>%
  select(-salary_chr, -downpay_ratio_raw)

# Ensure numeric car_value present
data_features <- data_features %>%
  mutate(
    car_value = if("car_value_num" %in% names(.)) 
      car_value_num 
    else 
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(car_value)))
  )

# Ensure the final 9 features exist
final_features <- c(
  "car_value",
  "salary_range",
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car",
  "payment_to_income",
  "downpayment_amount",
  "loan_to_value_ratio",
  "driver_tenure"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(final_features, names(data_features))
if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required feature columns after FE: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

# Build the final dataset (9 features + target)
data_final <- data_features %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure salary_range is a factor
    salary_range = if("salary_range" %in% names(.)) 
      as.factor(salary_range) 
    else 
      factor(NA),
    
    # Ensure loan_length stays
    loan_length = loan_length,
    
    # Standardize target 'repaid' → "Repaid"/"Not_Repaid"
    repaid = case_when(
      is.logical(repaid) ~ ifelse(repaid, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
      !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(repaid)))) ~
        ifelse(as.numeric(as.character(repaid)) == 1, "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
      tolower(as.character(repaid)) %in% c("1", "true", "t", "y", "yes") ~ "Repaid",
      tolower(as.character(repaid)) %in% c("0", "false", "f", "n", "no") ~ "Not_Repaid",
      TRUE ~ as.character(repaid)
    ),
    repaid = factor(repaid, levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(final_features), repaid, payment_to_income_flag)

# Basic validation & summary
cat("=== FEATURE ENGINEERING SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Final columns:", paste(names(data_final), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Number of rows:", nrow(data_final), "\n\n")

# Missing / infinite value checks
total_na <- sum(is.na(data_final))
total_inf <- sum(sapply(
  data_final %>% select(-repaid, -payment_to_income_flag),
  function(x) sum(!is.finite(x), na.rm = TRUE)
))

cat("Total NA in data_final:", total_na, "\n")
cat("Total infinite values in numeric features:", total_inf, "\n\n")

# Numeric feature summary
num_cols <- data_final %>%
  select(-salary_range, -repaid, -payment_to_income_flag) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  names()

if(length(num_cols) > 0) {
  cat("Numeric feature summary (mean, sd, min, max):\n")
  print(
    round(
      data_final %>%
        select(all_of(num_cols)) %>%
        summarise(across(
          everything(),
          list(
            mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
            min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
            max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
          )
        )),
      3
    ),
    n = Inf
  )
}

# Target distribution
cat("\nTarget ('repaid') distribution:\n")
print(table(data_final$repaid))
cat(sprintf("Repayment rate: %.2f%%\n", mean(data_final$repaid == "Repaid") * 100))

# payment_to_income diagnostics & export
cat("\npayment_to_income diagnostics:\n")
na_rate <- mean(is.na(data_final$payment_to_income))
cat(sprintf("  NA rate: %.2f%%\n", na_rate * 100))
cat("  Flags:\n")
print(table(data_final$payment_to_income_flag))

# Dump diagnostics if problematic
if(na_rate > 0.9) {
  message("WARNING: >90% payment_to_income is NA — writing diagnostics to 'payment_to_income_diagnostics.csv'")
  write.csv(
    data_final %>% 
      select(payment_to_income, payment_to_income_flag, downpayment_amount, 
             loan_to_value_ratio, loan_length, car_value, salary_range) %>% 
      head(500),
    "payment_to_income_diagnostics.csv", 
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

# Warn about constant column
non_na_vals <- unique(na.omit(data_final$payment_to_income))
if(length(non_na_vals) == 1 && nrow(data_final) > 10) {
  message("WARNING: payment_to_income is effectively constant. This can cause singularities in GLM.")
}

cat("\n✓ SECTION 3 COMPLETE\n")
cat("Please verify 'data_final' and review 'payment_to_income_diagnostics.csv' if generated.\n\n")

```

Section 4: Train-Test Split
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SECTION 4: TRAIN-TEST SPLIT (70/30)
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
})

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("SECTION 4: TRAIN-TEST SPLIT (70/30)\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# Configuration
set.seed(42)
out_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "eda_split_70_30")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Sanity checks
if(!exists("data_final")) {
  stop("'data_final' not found. Please run SECTION 3 (Feature Engineering) first.")
}

if(!"repaid" %in% names(data_final)) {
  stop("'data_final' must include the target column 'repaid'.")
}

# Define the 9 final features
# 更新特征列表 - 使用实际的虚拟变量列名
feature_cols <- c(
  "car_value",
  "salary_range.0...20K..",      # 替换原来的 salary_range
  "salary_range.20K...40K..",
  "salary_range.40K...60K..",
  "salary_range.60K...",
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car",
  "payment_to_income",
  "downpayment_amount",
  "loan_to_value_ratio",
  "driver_tenure"
)


# Check feature availability
missing_feats <- setdiff(final_features, names(data_final))
if(length(missing_feats) > 0) {
  stop("The following features are missing in 'data_final': ",
       paste(missing_feats, collapse = ", "))
}

# Subset dataset
df_all <- data_final %>% select(all_of(final_features), repaid)

# Standardize target levels
df_all$repaid <- factor(as.character(df_all$repaid),
                        levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))

# Unify global factor levels for salary_range
if("salary_range" %in% names(df_all)) {
  df_all$salary_range <- factor(
    as.character(df_all$salary_range),
    levels = sort(unique(as.character(df_all$salary_range)))
  )
}

# Stratified 70/30 split
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df_all$repaid, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df_all[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
test_data <- df_all[-train_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Re-align factor levels for salary_range
if("salary_range" %in% names(df_all)) {
  train_data$salary_range <- factor(
    as.character(train_data$salary_range),
    levels = levels(df_all$salary_range)
  )
  test_data$salary_range <- factor(
    as.character(test_data$salary_range),
    levels = levels(df_all$salary_range)
  )
}

# Optional: One-hot encode salary_range for models requiring numeric inputs
cat("Creating dummy variables for salary_range...\n")
if("salary_range" %in% names(df_all)) {
  # Ensure factor levels are aligned
  train_data$salary_range <- factor(
    as.character(train_data$salary_range),
    levels = levels(df_all$salary_range)
  )
  test_data$salary_range <- factor(
    as.character(test_data$salary_range),
    levels = levels(df_all$salary_range)
  )
  
  # Create dummy variables
  dummy <- dummyVars("~ salary_range", data = train_data)
  salary_train <- data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = train_data))
  salary_test <- data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = test_data))
  
  # Combine with other features
  train_data <- cbind(
    train_data %>% select(-salary_range), 
    salary_train
  )
  test_data <- cbind(
    test_data %>% select(-salary_range), 
    salary_test
  )
  
  cat("✓ Dummy variables created successfully\n\n")
}

# Summary output
cat("Data-split summary:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total observations: %d\n", nrow(df_all)))
cat(sprintf("  Training set: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            nrow(train_data),
            nrow(train_data) / nrow(df_all) * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Test set: %d (%.1f%%)\n\n",
            nrow(test_data),
            nrow(test_data) / nrow(df_all) * 100))

cat("Training-set distribution:\n")
print(table(train_data$repaid))
cat(sprintf("  Repayment rate: %.2f%%\n\n",
            mean(train_data$repaid == "Repaid") * 100))

cat("Test-set distribution:\n")
print(table(test_data$repaid))
cat(sprintf("  Repayment rate: %.2f%%\n\n",
            mean(test_data$repaid == "Repaid") * 100))

# Save outputs
saveRDS(train_data, file.path(out_dir, "train_data.rds"))
saveRDS(test_data, file.path(out_dir, "test_data.rds"))
write.csv(train_data, file.path(out_dir, "train_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(test_data, file.path(out_dir, "test_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(
  list(
    train_idx = train_idx,
    test_idx = setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df_all)), train_idx)
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "split_indices_70_30.rds")
)

cat("✓ Train/Test data saved to:", normalizePath(out_dir), "\n\n")
cat("✓ SECTION 4 COMPLETE\n\n")

```

Section 5: Model 1 - Logistic Regression
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SECTION 5: LOGISTIC REGRESSION MODEL (UPDATED: 10-fold CV + TRAIN & TEST METRICS)
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(pROC)
  library(car)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
})

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("SECTION 5: LOGISTIC REGRESSION MODEL\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# Configuration
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model1_lr_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
set.seed(42)

# Basic checks
if(!exists("train_data") || !exists("test_data")) {
  stop("train_data / test_data not found. Run SECTION 4 first.")
}

if(!"repaid" %in% names(train_data)) {
  stop("train_data must contain 'repaid' column")
}

if(!"repaid" %in% names(test_data)) {
  stop("test_data must contain 'repaid' column")
}

# Ensure target has expected levels
coerce_target <- function(vec) {
  v <- as.character(vec)
  u <- unique(na.omit(v))
  
  if(all(u %in% c("0", "1"))) {
    return(factor(ifelse(v == "1", "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"), 
                  levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid")))
  }
  
  if(all(u %in% c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))) {
    return(factor(v, levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid")))
  }
  
  # Fallback: treat second unique as positive
  if(length(u) == 2) {
    lv <- sort(u)
    return(factor(ifelse(v == lv[2], "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"), 
                  levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid")))
  }
  
  stop("Cannot coerce repaid to binary factor. Levels found: ", 
       paste(u, collapse = ", "))
}

train_data$repaid <- coerce_target(train_data$repaid)
test_data$repaid  <- coerce_target(test_data$repaid)

# Choose predictors: use all except 'repaid'
predictors <- setdiff(names(train_data), "repaid")
if(length(predictors) == 0) {
  stop("No predictors found in train_data")
}

cat("Predictors used:", paste(predictors, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# Align factor levels & simple imputation (train-derived)
impute_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if(length(ux) == 0) return(NA)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

for(col in predictors) {
  # Align factor levels using combined data if possible
  if(is.factor(train_data[[col]]) || is.character(train_data[[col]])) {
    # Get union levels from train+test
    lv <- sort(unique(na.omit(c(
      as.character(train_data[[col]]), 
      as.character(test_data[[col]])
    ))))
    
    train_data[[col]] <- factor(as.character(train_data[[col]]), levels = lv)
    test_data[[col]]  <- factor(as.character(test_data[[col]]),  levels = lv)
    
    # Impute mode
    m <- impute_mode(train_data[[col]])
    if(!is.na(m)) {
      train_data[[col]][is.na(train_data[[col]])] <- m
      test_data[[col]][is.na(test_data[[col]])]   <- m
    }
  } else {
    # Numeric: coerce numeric and impute median from train
    train_data[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(train_data[[col]])))
    test_data[[col]]  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(test_data[[col]])))
    
    med <- median(train_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    if(is.na(med)) med <- 0
    
    train_data[[col]][is.na(train_data[[col]])] <- med
    test_data[[col]][is.na(test_data[[col]])]   <- med
  }
}

# Save imputation map
impute_map <- tibble(
  feature = predictors,
  imputed = sapply(predictors, function(col) {
    if(is.numeric(train_data[[col]])) {
      median(train_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      impute_mode(train_data[[col]])
    }
  })
)

write.csv(impute_map, file.path(OUT_DIR, "imputation_map.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Imputation map saved\n\n")

# VIF check (on sampled design matrix)
cat("Computing VIF (Variance Inflation Factor)...\n")
design_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "), "-1"))

# Use a moderate sample to compute VIF
vif_sample_n <- min(3000, nrow(train_data))
vif_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(train_data)), size = vif_sample_n)

design_mat <- tryCatch(
  model.matrix(design_formula, data = train_data[vif_idx, , drop = FALSE]),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if(is.null(design_mat)) {
  warning("Could not build design matrix for VIF; skipping VIF computation.")
  vif_report <- tibble(feature = predictors, VIF = NA_real_)
} else {
  # Remove any constant columns
  nzvar <- apply(design_mat, 2, function(x) var(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE) != 0)
  design_mat2 <- design_mat[, nzvar, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Attempt glm and vif
  tmpdf <- data.frame(
    .y = as.numeric(train_data$repaid[vif_idx] == "Repaid"), 
    design_mat2
  )
  
  tmp_glm <- tryCatch(
    glm(.y ~ ., data = tmpdf, family = binomial),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if(is.null(tmp_glm)) {
    warning("glm for VIF failed; skipping detailed VIF.")
    vif_report <- tibble(feature = predictors, VIF = NA_real_)
  } else {
    vvals <- tryCatch(car::vif(tmp_glm), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if(is.null(vvals)) {
      vif_report <- tibble(feature = predictors, VIF = NA_real_)
    } else {
      # Simplify VIF computation
      if(is.matrix(vvals)) {
        vvals_vec <- vvals[, 1]
      } else {
        vvals_vec <- vvals
      }
      
      names(vvals_vec) <- names(vvals)
      
      # Aggregate by predictor
      vif_by_pred <- sapply(predictors, function(p) {
        matches <- grep(paste0("^", p), names(vvals_vec), value = TRUE)
        if(length(matches) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        max(as.numeric(vvals_vec[matches]), na.rm = TRUE)
      })
      
      vif_report <- tibble(feature = predictors, VIF = as.numeric(vif_by_pred))
    }
  }
}

write.csv(vif_report, file.path(OUT_DIR, "vif_report.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ VIF report saved\n\n")

# Train logistic regression using caret
cat("=== Training Logistic Regression (10-fold CV) ===\n")

train_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,                 # UPDATED: 10-fold CV
  classProbs = TRUE,

cat("\n=== TEST SET PERFORMANCE ===\n")

# Variable importance
```

```{r}
# --------
# Target coercion helper (to factor: Not_Repaid / Repaid)
# --------
coerce_target <- function(vec) {
  v <- as.character(vec)
  u <- sort(unique(na.omit(v)))
  if(all(u %in% c("0", "1"))) {
    return(factor(ifelse(v == "1", "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                  levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid")))
  }
  if(all(u %in% c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))) {
    return(factor(v, levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid")))
  }
  if(length(u) == 2) {
    return(factor(ifelse(v == u[2], "Repaid", "Not_Repaid"),
                  levels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid")))
  }
  stop("Cannot coerce 'repaid' to binary factor. Found levels: ",
       paste(u, collapse = ", "))
}

train_data$repaid <- coerce_target(train_data$repaid)
test_data$repaid <- coerce_target(test_data$repaid)

# Align categorical levels using template (if exists) or combined data
if(exists("data_final")) {
  template <- data_final
} else {
  template <- bind_rows(train_data, test_data)
}

for(col in feature_cols) {
  if(is.character(template[[col]]) || is.factor(template[[col]])) {
    levels_all <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.character(template[[col]]))))
    train_data[[col]] <- factor(as.character(train_data[[col]]), levels = levels_all)
    test_data[[col]] <- factor(as.character(test_data[[col]]), levels = levels_all)
  }
}

# Simple imputation using training-derived values
impute_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if(length(ux) == 0) return(NA)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

impute_map <- list()
for(col in feature_cols) {
  if(is.numeric(train_data[[col]]) || is.integer(train_data[[col]])) {
    train_data[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(train_data[[col]]))
    test_data[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(test_data[[col]]))
    med <- median(train_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    if(is.na(med)) med <- 0
    train_data[[col]][is.na(train_data[[col]])] <- med
    test_data[[col]][is.na(test_data[[col]])] <- med
    impute_map[[col]] <- med
  } else {
    train_data[[col]] <- factor(as.character(train_data[[col]]),
                                levels = levels(train_data[[col]]))
    test_data[[col]] <- factor(as.character(test_data[[col]]),
                               levels = levels(train_data[[col]]))
    m <- impute_mode(train_data[[col]])
    if(is.na(m)) m <- NA_character_
    train_data[[col]][is.na(train_data[[col]])] <- m
    test_data[[col]][is.na(test_data[[col]])] <- m
    impute_map[[col]] <- as.character(m)
  }
}

# Save imputation summary
impute_df <- tibble::enframe(impute_map, name = "feature", value = "imputed_value") %>%
  mutate(imputed_value = sapply(imputed_value, function(x) {

if(any(nzv$nzv)) {

if(is.null(rf_fit)) stop("Random Forest training failed. Please check data or memory.")

# Cross-validation summary + best tune

# ---------------------------

# Confusion matrices

cm_test  <- confusionMatrix(test_pred_class, test_data$repaid, positive = "Repaid")

# ROC objects

                          predictor = as.numeric(train_pred_prob[,"Repaid"])), error = function(e) NULL)

                          predictor = as.numeric(test_pred_prob[,"Repaid"])), error = function(e) NULL)

# ---------------------------
# Robust metrics function (safe TP/TN/FP/FN and MCC)
# ---------------------------
compute_metrics_from_cm_roc <- function(cm, roc_obj = NULL) {
  res <- list()
  # Ensure cm$table exists
  if (is.null(cm) || is.null(cm$table)) {
    warning("compute_metrics_from_cm_roc: confusion matrix or cm$table is NULL")
    res$TP <- res$TN <- res$FP <- res$FN <- 0
    res$Accuracy <- res$Sensitivity <- res$Specificity <- res$Precision <- res$F1_Score <- NA_real_
    res$AUC <- res$Gini <- res$KS <- res$MCC <- NA_real_
    return(res)
  }

  tbl <- as.matrix(cm$table)

  # Safe extraction: check names, fallback to positions if needed
  get_cell <- function(r, c) {
    if (!is.null(rownames(tbl)) && !is.null(colnames(tbl)) &&
        r %in% rownames(tbl) && c %in% colnames(tbl)) {
      val <- tbl[r, c]
      if (is.na(val)) return(0)
      return(as.numeric(val))
    } else {
      # try numeric position fallback (if table is 2x2)
      if (nrow(tbl) >= 2 && ncol(tbl) >= 2) {
        a <- as.numeric(tbl[1,1]); b <- as.numeric(tbl[1,2])
        c_ <- as.numeric(tbl[2,1]); d <- as.numeric(tbl[2,2])
        a <- ifelse(is.na(a), 0, a); b <- ifelse(is.na(b), 0, b)
        c_ <- ifelse(is.na(c_), 0, c_); d <- ifelse(is.na(d), 0, d)
        if (r == "Repaid" && c == "Repaid") return(d)
        if (r == "Not_Repaid" && c == "Not_Repaid") return(a)
        if (r == "Repaid" && c == "Not_Repaid") return(c_)
        if (r == "Not_Repaid" && c == "Repaid") return(b)
      }
      return(0)
    }
  }

  TP <- get_cell("Repaid", "Repaid")
  TN <- get_cell("Not_Repaid", "Not_Repaid")
  FP <- get_cell("Repaid", "Not_Repaid")
  FN <- get_cell("Not_Repaid", "Repaid")

  # ensure numeric (double)
  TP <- as.numeric(TP); TN <- as.numeric(TN); FP <- as.numeric(FP); FN <- as.numeric(FN)
  res$TP <- as.integer(TP); res$TN <- as.integer(TN); res$FP <- as.integer(FP); res$FN <- as.integer(FN)

  # caret metrics (may be NA)
  res$Accuracy    <- if(!is.null(cm$overall["Accuracy"])) as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]) else NA_real_
  res$Sensitivity <- if(!is.null(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]) else NA_real_
  res$Specificity <- if(!is.null(cm$byClass["Specificity"])) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]) else NA_real_
  res$Precision   <- if(!is.null(cm$byClass["Precision"])) as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"]) else NA_real_
  res$F1_Score    <- if(!is.null(cm$byClass["F1"])) as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]) else NA_real_

  # AUC / Gini / KS
  if(!is.null(roc_obj)) {
    auc_val <- tryCatch(as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    res$AUC <- auc_val
    res$Gini <- ifelse(is.na(auc_val), NA_real_, 2 * auc_val - 1)
    sens <- roc_obj$sensitivities
    spec <- roc_obj$specificities
    if (!is.null(sens) && !is.null(spec) && length(sens) == length(spec)) {
      tpr <- sens
      fpr <- 1 - spec
      res$KS <- max(abs(tpr - fpr), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      res$KS <- NA_real_
    }
  } else {
    res$AUC <- res$Gini <- res$KS <- NA_real_
  }

  # MCC: safe compute with NA guards
  denom <- tryCatch(sqrt((TP + FP) * (TP + FN) * (TN + FP) * (TN + FN)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  if (is.na(denom) || denom == 0) {
    res$MCC <- NA_real_
  } else {
    res$MCC <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denom
  }

  return(res)
}

# Compute metrics
metrics_train <- compute_metrics_from_cm_roc(cm_train, roc_train)
metrics_test  <- compute_metrics_from_cm_roc(cm_test,  roc_test)

# Print Train metrics
cat("\n=== TRAIN METRICS ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", metrics_train$Accuracy))
cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", metrics_train$Sensitivity))
cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", metrics_train$Specificity))
cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", metrics_train$Precision))
cat(sprintf("F1: %.6f\n", metrics_train$F1_Score))
cat(sprintf("AUC: %.6f\n", ifelse(is.na(metrics_train$AUC), NA, metrics_train$AUC)))
cat(sprintf("Gini: %.6f\n", ifelse(is.na(metrics_train$Gini), NA, metrics_train$Gini)))
cat(sprintf("KS: %.6f\n", ifelse(is.na(metrics_train$KS), NA, metrics_train$KS)))
cat(sprintf("MCC: %s\n", ifelse(is.na(metrics_train$MCC), "NA", format(metrics_train$MCC, digits = 6))))
cat(sprintf("TP: %d | TN: %d | FP: %d | FN: %d\n", metrics_train$TP, metrics_train$TN, metrics_train$FP, metrics_train$FN))
cat("Confusion Matrix (TRAIN):\n"); print(cm_train$table)

# Print Test metrics
cat("\n=== TEST METRICS ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Accuracy:  %.6f\n", metrics_test$Accuracy))
cat(sprintf("Sensitivity: %.6f\n", metrics_test$Sensitivity))
cat(sprintf("Specificity: %.6f\n", metrics_test$Specificity))
cat(sprintf("Precision: %.6f\n", metrics_test$Precision))

cat("Confusion Matrix (TEST):\n"); print(cm_test$table)

# ---------------------------
# Save metrics to CSV (side-by-side)
# ---------------------------
metrics_to_row <- function(m, set_name) {
  data.frame(
    Set = set_name,
    Accuracy = m$Accuracy,
    Sensitivity = m$Sensitivity,
    Specificity = m$Specificity,
    Precision = m$Precision,
    F1 = m$F1_Score,
    AUC = m$AUC,
    Gini = m$Gini,
    KS = m$KS,
    MCC = m$MCC,
    TP = m$TP,
    TN = m$TN,
    FP = m$FP,
    FN = m$FN,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

metrics_df <- bind_rows(metrics_to_row(metrics_train, "Train"),
                        metrics_to_row(metrics_test,  "Test"))
write.csv(metrics_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_test_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n✓ Saved train/test metrics to:", file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_test_metrics.csv"), "\n")

# Save confusion matrices and predictions
write.csv(as.data.frame(cm_train$table), file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_confusion_train.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(cm_test$table), file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_confusion_test.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    Pred = as.character(train_pred_class),
    Prob_Repaid = train_pred_prob$Repaid,
    Actual = as.character(train_data$repaid)
  ), file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_train_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    Pred = as.character(test_pred_class),
    Prob_Repaid = test_pred_prob$Repaid,
    Actual = as.character(test_data$repaid)
  ), file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_test_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Save model object & importance
saveRDS(rf_fit, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_fit_caret.rds"))

# Feature Importance Extraction (existing logic preserved)
imp_df <- NULL
vi_try <- tryCatch({
  v <- varImp(rf_fit)
  if(is.list(v) && "importance" %in% names(v)) {
    imp_tmp <- as.data.frame(v$importance)
    col_imp <- if("Overall" %in% colnames(imp_tmp)) "Overall" else colnames(imp_tmp)[1]
    tibble(Feature = rownames(imp_tmp), Importance = imp_tmp[[col_imp]]) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance))
  } else {
    stop("Unexpected varImp structure")
  }
}, error = function(e) NULL)

if(is.null(vi_try)) {
  native_try <- tryCatch({
    if(use_ranger) {
      rf_native <- rf_fit$finalModel
      imp_mat <- ranger::importance(rf_native)
      tibble(Feature = names(imp_mat), Importance = as.numeric(imp_mat)) %>%
        arrange(desc(Importance))
    } else {
      rf_native <- rf_fit$finalModel
      imp_mat <- randomForest::importance(rf_native)
      if(is.matrix(imp_mat)) {
        col_use <- intersect(c("MeanDecreaseGini", "MeanDecreaseAccuracy"),
                            colnames(imp_mat))[1]
        tibble(Feature = rownames(imp_mat),
               Importance = as.numeric(imp_mat[, col_use])) %>%
          arrange(desc(Importance))
      } else {
        tibble(Feature = names(imp_mat), Importance = as.numeric(imp_mat)) %>%
          arrange(desc(Importance))
      }
    }
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  imp_df <- if(!is.null(native_try)) native_try else tibble(Feature = feature_cols, Importance = 0)
} else {
  imp_df <- vi_try
}

# Ensure all original features appear in importance
if(!all(feature_cols %in% imp_df$Feature)) {
  missing_feats <- setdiff(feature_cols, imp_df$Feature)
  imp_df <- bind_rows(imp_df, tibble(Feature = missing_feats, Importance = 0)) %>%
    filter(Feature %in% c(feature_cols, Feature)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance))
}
write.csv(imp_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_feature_importance.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ROC Plots for train and test (and combined)
if(!is.null(roc_train)) {
  png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_roc_train.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
  plot(roc_train, main = sprintf("Random Forest ROC (Train AUC=%.4f)", metrics_train$AUC), lwd = 2)
  dev.off()
}
if(!is.null(roc_test)) {
  png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_roc_test.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
  plot(roc_test, main = sprintf("Random Forest ROC (Test AUC=%.4f)", metrics_test$AUC), lwd = 2)

}
if(!is.null(roc_train) && !is.null(roc_test)) {
  png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rf_roc_train_vs_test.png"), width = 900, height = 700)
  plot(roc_train, col = "blue", lwd = 2, main = "ROC: Train (blue) vs Test (red)")
  lines(roc_test, col = "red", lwd = 2)
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = c(sprintf("Train AUC=%.4f", metrics_train$AUC), sprintf("Test AUC=%.4f", metrics_test$AUC)),
         col = c("blue","red"), lwd = 2)
  dev.off()
}
```

Section 7: Model 3 - XGBoost
```{r}
# SECTION 7 (REVISED): Robust XGBOOST MODEL (train+test metrics + safe handling)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(xgboost)
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(pROC)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Matrix)
})

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("SECTION 7: XGBOOST MODEL (REVISED)\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# Configuration
OUT_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model3_xgb_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
set.seed(42)

# Basic data checks (train_data/test_data must exist from previous sections)
if (!exists("train_data") || !exists("test_data")) {
  stop("Please run SECTION 4 (data prep) first: ensure 'train_data' & 'test_data' exist in the global environment.")
}

if (!"repaid" %in% names(train_data)) stop("train_data must contain the 'repaid' target column.")
if (!"repaid" %in% names(test_data))  stop("test_data must contain the 'repaid' target column.")

# ----------------- helpers -----------------
to_bin01 <- function(x) {
  # map common representations to 0/1 (1 -> positive / Repaid)
  if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
  sx <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- ifelse(sx %in% c("1","true","t","yes","y","repaid","paid"), 1,
         ifelse(sx %in% c("0","false","f","no","n","not_repaid","notrepaid","not repaid"), 0, NA))
  # if still NA but numeric-like, coerce
  nas <- is.na(out)
  if (any(nas)) {
    asnum <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    out[nas] <- ifelse(!is.na(asnum[nas]) & asnum[nas] == 1, 1,
                       ifelse(!is.na(asnum[nas]) & asnum[nas] == 0, 0, out[nas]))
  }
  out
}

safe_feature_cols_from_salary <- function(df, prefix = "salary_range") {
  # if salary_range dummies already present (salary_range.<level>), return them
  have <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, "\\."), names(df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(have) > 0) return(have)
  # else if salary_range column exists, create dummies (one-hot, fullRank=FALSE)
  if (prefix %in% names(df)) {
    dvm <- caret::dummyVars(~ salary_range, data = df, fullRank = FALSE)
    m <- predict(dvm, newdata = df)
    colnames(m) <- gsub("^salary_range", "salary_range", colnames(m))
    return(colnames(m))
  }
  character(0)
}

compute_basic_metrics <- function(y_true_01, y_prob = NULL, threshold = 0.5) {
  # y_true_01 numeric vector 0/1
  y_pred01 <- if (!is.null(y_prob)) ifelse(y_prob >= threshold, 1, 0) else NA
  # if y_pred01 has NA, cannot compute confusion-based metrics
  res <- list()
  if (!any(is.na(y_pred01))) {
    cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(factor(y_pred01, levels = c(0,1)),
                                 factor(y_true_01, levels = c(0,1)),
                                 positive = "1")
    res$confusion <- cm$table
    res$Accuracy <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])
    res$Sensitivity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])
    res$Specificity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])
    res$Precision <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])
    res$F1 <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
    res$Kappa <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Kappa"])
  } else {
    res$confusion <- NULL
    res$Accuracy <- NA; res$Sensitivity <- NA; res$Specificity <- NA; res$Precision <- NA; res$F1 <- NA; res$Kappa <- NA
  }
  # ROC/AUC, Gini, KS
  if (!is.null(y_prob) && length(y_prob) == length(y_true_01)) {
    rocobj <- tryCatch(pROC::roc(y_true_01, as.numeric(y_prob), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(rocobj)) {
      aucv <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(rocobj))
      res$AUC <- aucv
      res$Gini <- 2 * aucv - 1
      sensv <- rocobj$sensitivities; specv <- rocobj$specificities
      if (!is.null(sensv) && !is.null(specv) && length(sensv) == length(specv)) res$KS <- max(abs(sensv - (1 - specv))) else res$KS <- NA
      res$rocobj <- rocobj
    } else {
      res$AUC <- NA; res$Gini <- NA; res$KS <- NA; res$rocobj <- NULL
    }
  } else {
    res$AUC <- NA; res$Gini <- NA; res$KS <- NA; res$rocobj <- NULL
  }
  res
}

# ----------------- feature list -----------------
# base_features (as in your SECTION 7)
base_features <- c(
  "car_value",
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car",
  "payment_to_income",
  "downpayment_amount",
  "loan_to_value_ratio",
  "driver_tenure"
)

# detect salary_range dummy columns (salary_range.*) OR salary_range column
salary_range_cols_train <- grep("^salary_range\\.", names(train_data), value = TRUE)
salary_range_cols_test  <- grep("^salary_range\\.", names(test_data),  value = TRUE)

if (length(salary_range_cols_train) == 0 && "salary_range" %in% names(train_data)) {
  # create dummy vars for both train and test using caret::dummyVars (ensure consistent levels)
  dv <- dummyVars(~ salary_range, data = bind_rows(train_data %>% select(salary_range), test_data %>% select(salary_range)), fullRank = FALSE)
  all_dummy <- predict(dv, newdata = bind_rows(train_data %>% select(salary_range), test_data %>% select(salary_range)))
  # split back
  ntr <- nrow(train_data)
  train_dum <- as.data.frame(all_dummy[1:ntr, , drop = FALSE])
  test_dum  <- as.data.frame(all_dummy[(ntr + 1):nrow(all_dummy), , drop = FALSE])
  # add to train/test (prefix with salary_range.)
  colnames(train_dum) <- paste0("salary_range.", colnames(train_dum))
  colnames(test_dum)  <- paste0("salary_range.", colnames(test_dum))
  train_data <- bind_cols(train_data, train_dum)
  test_data  <- bind_cols(test_data,  test_dum)
  salary_range_cols_train <- colnames(train_dum)
  salary_range_cols_test  <- colnames(test_dum)
}

# final feature_cols
feature_cols <- unique(c(base_features, salary_range_cols_train))
cat("Total features to use:", length(feature_cols), "\n")
cat("Feature list:\n"); print(feature_cols); cat("\n")

# Validate features exist in train/test (if test missing some salary dummies, create zeros)
missing_train <- setdiff(feature_cols, names(train_data))
missing_test  <- setdiff(feature_cols, names(test_data))
if (length(missing_train) > 0) stop("Required features missing in train_data: ", paste(missing_train, collapse = ", "))
if (length(missing_test)  > 0) {
  # add zero columns to test_data for missing predictors
  for (nm in missing_test) test_data[[nm]] <- 0
  warning("Added missing feature columns to test_data (filled with 0): ", paste(missing_test, collapse = ", "))
}

# ----------------- prepare X/y -----------------
# ensure numeric conversion for numeric columns used
for (nm in feature_cols) {
  if (nm %in% names(train_data)) {
    if (is.factor(train_data[[nm]])) train_data[[nm]] <- as.numeric(as.character(train_data[[nm]]))
    train_data[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(train_data[[nm]]))
  }
  if (nm %in% names(test_data)) {
    if (is.factor(test_data[[nm]])) test_data[[nm]] <- as.numeric(as.character(test_data[[nm]]))
    test_data[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(test_data[[nm]]))
  }
}

# Map target to 0/1 robustly
y_train01 <- to_bin01(train_data$repaid)
y_test01  <- to_bin01(test_data$repaid)
if (any(is.na(y_train01))) stop("Cannot coerce some train_data$repaid values to 0/1. Inspect target values.")
if (any(is.na(y_test01)))  stop("Cannot coerce some test_data$repaid values to 0/1. Inspect target values.")

# Build matrices (use sparse if many dummies)
X_train <- as.matrix(train_data %>% select(all_of(feature_cols)))
X_test  <- as.matrix(test_data %>% select(all_of(feature_cols)))

cat("Training samples:", nrow(X_train), "\n")
cat("Test samples:", nrow(X_test), "\n")
cat("Number of features:", ncol(X_train), "\n\n")

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train01)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test,  label = y_test01)

# ----------------- training -----------------
cat("Training XGBoost model...\n")
xgb_params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  gamma = 0
)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = xgb_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 100,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest),
  early_stopping_rounds = 10,
  verbose = 1,
  print_every_n = 10
)

cat("\n✓ XGBoost model training complete\n\n")

# ----------------- predictions & metrics (train + test) -----------------
# predict probabilities
train_pred_prob <- predict(xgb_model, dtrain)
test_pred_prob  <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)

train_pred_class <- ifelse(train_pred_prob >= 0.5, 1, 0)
test_pred_class  <- ifelse(test_pred_prob  >= 0.5, 1, 0)

# compute metrics
train_metrics <- compute_basic_metrics(y_train01, train_pred_prob, threshold = 0.5)
test_metrics  <- compute_basic_metrics(y_test01,  test_pred_prob,  threshold = 0.5)

# print confusion & metrics
cat("=== TRAIN confusion matrix ===\n"); print(train_metrics$confusion); cat("\n")
cat("=== TRAIN metrics ===\n")
print(tibble::tibble(
  Model = "XGBoost", Set = "TRAIN",
  Accuracy = train_metrics$Accuracy, Precision = train_metrics$Precision,
  Recall = train_metrics$Sensitivity, F1 = train_metrics$F1,
  Specificity = train_metrics$Specificity, AUC = train_metrics$AUC,
  Kappa = train_metrics$Kappa, Gini = train_metrics$Gini, KS = train_metrics$KS
))
cat("\n=== TEST confusion matrix ===\n"); print(test_metrics$confusion); cat("\n")
cat("=== TEST metrics ===\n")
print(tibble::tibble(
  Model = "XGBoost", Set = "TEST",
  Accuracy = test_metrics$Accuracy, Precision = test_metrics$Precision,
  Recall = test_metrics$Sensitivity, F1 = test_metrics$F1,
  Specificity = test_metrics$Specificity, AUC = test_metrics$AUC,
  Kappa = test_metrics$Kappa, Gini = test_metrics$Gini, KS = test_metrics$KS
))

# ----------------- save preds, metrics, confusion, ROC plots -----------------
# predictions (save 0/1 labels + probs + original target if present)
train_out <- data.frame(
  actual = y_train01,
  pred_class = train_pred_class,
  pred_prob = train_pred_prob
)
test_out <- data.frame(
  actual = y_test01,
  pred_class = test_pred_class,
  pred_prob = test_pred_prob
)
write.csv(train_out, file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_train_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(test_out,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_test_predictions.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)

# metrics table
metrics_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(Model = "XGBoost", Set = "TRAIN",
                 Accuracy = train_metrics$Accuracy, Precision = train_metrics$Precision,
                 Recall = train_metrics$Sensitivity, F1 = train_metrics$F1,
                 Specificity = train_metrics$Specificity, AUC = train_metrics$AUC,
                 Kappa = train_metrics$Kappa, Gini = train_metrics$Gini, KS = train_metrics$KS),
  tibble::tibble(Model = "XGBoost", Set = "TEST",
                 Accuracy = test_metrics$Accuracy, Precision = test_metrics$Precision,
                 Recall = test_metrics$Sensitivity, F1 = test_metrics$F1,
                 Specificity = test_metrics$Specificity, AUC = test_metrics$AUC,
                 Kappa = test_metrics$Kappa, Gini = test_metrics$Gini, KS = test_metrics$KS)
)
write.csv(metrics_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_train_test_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# confusion matrices
if (!is.null(train_metrics$confusion)) write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(train_metrics$confusion), file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_train_confusion.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
if (!is.null(test_metrics$confusion))  write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(test_metrics$confusion),  file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_test_confusion.csv"),  row.names = TRUE)

# ROC plots
if (!is.null(train_metrics$rocobj)) {
  png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_train_roc.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
  plot(train_metrics$rocobj, main = sprintf("XGBoost Train ROC (AUC=%.4f)", train_metrics$AUC))
  dev.off()
}
if (!is.null(test_metrics$rocobj)) {
  png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "xgb_test_roc.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
  plot(test_metrics$rocobj, main = sprintf("XGBoost Test ROC (AUC=%.4f)", test_metrics$AUC))
  dev.off()
}

# ----------------- feature importance & plots -----------------
importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(X_train), model = xgb_model)
if (!is.null(importance_matrix) && nrow(importance_matrix) > 0) {
  cat("Top 10 Important Features:\n"); print(head(importance_matrix, 10)); cat("\n")

    dev.off()

# ----------------- save model -----------------

tryCatch({
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: MODEL COMPARISON AND EVALUATION (Robust)
# - Compares available models on the TEST set
# - Recomputes preds/probs if needed
# ============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(pROC)
})

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("STEP 8: MODEL COMPARISON AND EVALUATION (Robust)\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# Create summary directory
SUMMARY_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model_comparison_summary")
dir.create(SUMMARY_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# Basic checks
# ---------------------------
if (!exists("test_data")) stop("Error: test_data not found. Please run STEP 4 and ensure test_data exists.")
if (!"repaid" %in% names(test_data)) stop("Error: test_data must contain 'repaid' column for evaluation.")

# Helper: safe predict class & prob for caret model or existing vars
get_preds_from_model <- function(model_name, model_obj = NULL, test_df) {
  # Returns list(success, pred_class, pred_prob, message)
  res <- list(success = FALSE, pred_class = NULL, pred_prob = NULL, message = NULL)
  tryCatch({
    if (!is.null(model_obj)) {
      # compute class and prob via predict (caret-compatible)
      pred_class <- tryCatch(predict(model_obj, newdata = test_df, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
      pred_prob  <- tryCatch(predict(model_obj, newdata = test_df, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL)
      res$pred_class <- pred_class
      res$pred_prob  <- pred_prob
      res$success <- TRUE
    } else {
      res$message <- "No model object provided"
    }
  }, error = function(e){
    res$success <- FALSE
    res$message <- paste("Predict error:", e$message)
  })
  return(res)
}

# ---------------------------
# Models to check (support alternate naming: lr_model/logit_model, etc.)
# ---------------------------
model_map <- list(
  "Logistic Regression" = if (exists("lr_model")) lr_model else if (exists("logit_model")) logit_model else NULL,
  "Random Forest"       = if (exists("rf_model")) rf_model else NULL,
  "XGBoost"             = if (exists("xgb_model")) xgb_model else NULL
)

# Also accept precomputed preds/probs if available
precomp_preds <- list(
  "Logistic Regression" = list(
    class = if (exists("lr_pred")) lr_pred else if (exists("logit_pred")) logit_pred else NULL,
    prob  = if (exists("lr_pred_prob")) lr_pred_prob else if (exists("logit_pred_prob")) logit_pred_prob else NULL
  ),
  "Random Forest" = list(
    class = if (exists("rf_pred")) rf_pred else NULL,
    prob  = if (exists("rf_pred_prob")) rf_pred_prob else NULL
  ),
  "XGBoost" = list(
    class = if (exists("xgb_pred")) xgb_pred else NULL,
    prob  = if (exists("xgb_pred_prob")) xgb_pred_prob else NULL
  )
)

# Determine available models (either model object exists or precomputed preds exist)
available_models <- c()
for (mn in names(model_map)) {
  if (!is.null(model_map[[mn]]) || (!is.null(precomp_preds[[mn]]$class) || !is.null(precomp_preds[[mn]]$prob))) {
    available_models <- c(available_models, mn)
  }
}

if (length(available_models) == 0) stop("No models or precomputed predictions found (lr_model/logit_model, rf_model, xgb_model or lr_pred etc.).")

cat("Models to be compared:\n")
print(available_models)
cat("\n")

# ---------------------------
# Compute metrics per model (on TEST set)
# ---------------------------
results_list <- list()
roc_objects <- list()

for (mn in available_models) {
  cat("Processing model:", mn, "...\n")
  model_obj <- model_map[[mn]]
  # start with precomputed preds if present
  pred_class <- NULL
  pred_prob  <- NULL

  if (!is.null(precomp_preds[[mn]]$class)) {
    pred_class <- precomp_preds[[mn]]$class
  }
  if (!is.null(precomp_preds[[mn]]$prob)) {
    pred_prob <- precomp_preds[[mn]]$prob
  }

  # If missing, try to compute from model object
  if (is.null(pred_class) || is.null(pred_prob)) {
    if (!is.null(model_obj)) {
      pr <- get_preds_from_model(mn, model_obj, test_data)
      if (pr$success) {
        if (is.null(pred_class) && !is.null(pr$pred_class)) pred_class <- pr$pred_class
        if (is.null(pred_prob)  && !is.null(pr$pred_prob))  pred_prob  <- pr$pred_prob
      } else {
        warning(sprintf("Could not generate preds for %s: %s", mn, pr$message))
      }
    } else {
      warning(sprintf("No model object for %s and no precomputed preds found.", mn))
    }
  }

  # Validate presence of predicted class; if still null, skip model
  if (is.null(pred_class)) {
    warning(sprintf("Skipping %s: predicted classes not available.", mn))
    next
  }

  # Ensure pred_class is factor with same levels as test_data$repaid if possible
  if (!is.factor(pred_class)) {
    pred_class <- as.character(pred_class)
    if (all(pred_class %in% c("Repaid","Not_Repaid"))) {
      pred_class <- factor(pred_class, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
    } else if (all(pred_class %in% c("0","1","0.0","1.0"))) {
      pred_class[pred_class %in% c("0","0.0")] <- "Not_Repaid"
      pred_class[pred_class %in% c("1","1.0")] <- "Repaid"
      pred_class <- factor(pred_class, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
    } else {
      # try align to test_data levels
      try({
        pred_class <- factor(as.character(pred_class), levels = levels(test_data$repaid))
      }, silent = TRUE)
    }
  }

  # Compute confusionMatrix only if test labels exist and are not all NA
  metrics <- list()
  if (!all(is.na(test_data$repaid))) {
    # if pred_class length mismatch, warn and continue
    if (length(pred_class) != nrow(test_data)) {
      warning(sprintf("%s: length(pred_class) != nrow(test_data) — skipping metrics for this model.", mn))
      next
    }
    actual <- test_data$repaid
    if (!is.factor(actual)) actual <- factor(actual)
    # align levels if needed
    if (!all(levels(pred_class) %in% levels(actual))) {
      pred_class <- factor(as.character(pred_class), levels = levels(actual))
    }

    cm <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_class, actual, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(cm)) {
      warning(sprintf("%s: confusionMatrix failed — skipping.", mn))
      next
    }
    metrics$Accuracy    <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])
    metrics$Sensitivity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])
    metrics$Specificity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])
    metrics$Precision   <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])
    metrics$F1_Score    <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
    metrics$Confusion   <- cm$table
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("test_data has no labels (all NA). Skipping confusion/metrics for %s.", mn))
  }

  # ROC-AUC: need numeric probability for positive class "Repaid"
  auc_val <- NA_real_
  roc_obj <- NULL
  if (!is.null(pred_prob) && is.data.frame(pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(pred_prob) && !all(is.na(test_data$repaid))) {
    if (nrow(pred_prob) == nrow(test_data)) {
      roc_obj <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(test_data$repaid == "Repaid"),
                              predictor = as.numeric(pred_prob[,"Repaid"]), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(roc_obj)) {
        auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
      }
    } else {
      warning(sprintf("%s: predicted-prob length != nrow(test_data), cannot compute ROC.", mn))
    }
  } else {
    if (!is.null(pred_prob) && is.numeric(pred_prob) && length(pred_prob) == nrow(test_data) && !all(is.na(test_data$repaid))) {
      roc_obj <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(test_data$repaid == "Repaid"),
                              predictor = as.numeric(pred_prob), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(roc_obj)) auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
    }
  }

  metrics$ROC_AUC <- auc_val

  # store outputs
  results_list[[mn]] <- list(metrics = metrics, pred_class = pred_class, pred_prob = pred_prob)
  roc_objects[[mn]] <- roc_obj

  # print confusion matrix + basic metrics immediately for user
  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s ---\n", mn))
  if (!is.null(metrics$Confusion)) {
    cat("Confusion Matrix (TEST):\n"); print(metrics$Confusion)
    cat(sprintf("Accuracy: %.4f | Sensitivity: %.4f | Specificity: %.4f | Precision: %.4f | F1: %.4f | ROC-AUC: %s\n\n",
                metrics$Accuracy, metrics$Sensitivity, metrics$Specificity, metrics$Precision, metrics$F1_Score,
                ifelse(is.na(metrics$ROC_AUC), "NA", sprintf("%.4f", metrics$ROC_AUC))))
  } else {
    cat("No confusion/metrics (test labels missing)\n\n")
  }
}

# ---------------------------
# Build comparison table (only metrics present)
# ---------------------------
if (length(results_list) == 0) stop("No model produced metrics; cannot compare.")

metric_names <- c("Accuracy","Sensitivity","Specificity","Precision","F1_Score","ROC_AUC")
comp_df <- data.frame(Model = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (mn in names(results_list)) {
  m <- results_list[[mn]]$metrics
  row <- sapply(metric_names, function(k) if (!is.null(m[[k]])) as.numeric(m[[k]]) else NA_real_)
  comp_df <- rbind(comp_df, data.frame(Model = mn, t(row), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
rownames(comp_df) <- NULL
colnames(comp_df) <- c("Model", metric_names)

# round for nicer display
comp_df[metric_names] <- lapply(comp_df[metric_names], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA, round(x, 6)))

cat("\n=== Performance Comparison Table (TEST) ===\n")
print(comp_df)
cat("\n")

# Save comparison table to CSV
comp_csv_path <- file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "model_comparison_test_metrics.csv")
write.csv(comp_df, comp_csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved comparison CSV to:", comp_csv_path, "\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# Best model per metric
# ---------------------------
cat("=== Best Model per Metric ===\n\n")
for (mn in metric_names) {
  vals <- comp_df[[mn]]
  if (all(is.na(vals))) {
    cat(sprintf("- %s: no values\n", mn)); next
  }
  best_idx <- which.max(vals)
  cat(sprintf("- %s: %s (%.6f)\n", mn, comp_df$Model[best_idx], vals[best_idx]))
}
cat("\n")

# ---------------------------
# Overall ranking by average rank across metrics (lower avg rank = better)
# robust implementation that ensures rank_matrix is a matrix
# ---------------------------

# Sanity checks
if (nrow(comp_df) == 0) stop("comp_df is empty; cannot rank models.")
if (!all(metric_names %in% colnames(comp_df))) {
  warning("Some metric_names are missing from comp_df. Using intersection.")
  metric_names <- intersect(metric_names, colnames(comp_df))
  if (length(metric_names) == 0) stop("No metrics available to rank.")
}

# Build rank matrix as list then cbind (this avoids sapply simplification)
rank_list <- lapply(metric_names, function(k) {
  v <- comp_df[[k]]
  # if the entire column is NA -> return NA vector of length nrow(comp_df)
  if (all(is.na(v))) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(comp_df)))
  }
  # compute descending rank (best -> rank 1)
  rank(-v, ties.method = "average", na.last = "keep")
})

# Combine into a matrix (n_models x n_metrics)
rank_matrix <- do.call(cbind, rank_list)
colnames(rank_matrix) <- metric_names
rownames(rank_matrix) <- comp_df$Model

# now compute average rank across metrics, ignoring NA
avg_rank <- rowMeans(rank_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_rank[is.nan(avg_rank)] <- NA_real_
comp_df$Avg_Rank <- round(avg_rank, 6)

order_idx <- order(comp_df$Avg_Rank, na.last = TRUE)
cat("=== Overall Ranking (by average rank across metrics) ===\n\n")
print(comp_df[order_idx, ])
cat("\nOverall best model (lowest Avg_Rank): ", comp_df$Model[order_idx[1]], "\n\n")

# Save ranked comparison
ranked_csv_path <- file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "model_comparison_ranked.csv")
write.csv(comp_df[order_idx, ], ranked_csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved ranked comparison CSV to:", ranked_csv_path, "\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# Save best model summary (based on Avg_Rank first, fallback to ROC_AUC)
# ---------------------------
best_overall <- comp_df$Model[order_idx[1]]
best_row <- comp_df[comp_df$Model == best_overall, , drop = FALSE]

# fallback: if Avg_Rank NA, choose max ROC_AUC
if (is.na(best_row$Avg_Rank) || length(best_row$Avg_Rank) == 0) {
  if (!all(is.na(comp_df$ROC_AUC))) {
    best_overall <- comp_df$Model[which.max(comp_df$ROC_AUC)]
    best_row <- comp_df[comp_df$Model == best_overall, , drop = FALSE]
  }
}

best_summary_path <- file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "best_model_summary.txt")
writeLines(
  c(
    paste("Best Model (by Avg_Rank or ROC_AUC):", best_overall),
    paste("Avg_Rank:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$Avg_Rank), "NA", best_row$Avg_Rank)),
    paste("ROC_AUC:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$ROC_AUC), "NA", best_row$ROC_AUC)),
    paste("Accuracy:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$Accuracy), "NA", best_row$Accuracy)),
    paste("Precision:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$Precision), "NA", best_row$Precision)),
    paste("Sensitivity (Recall):", ifelse(is.na(best_row$Sensitivity), "NA", best_row$Sensitivity)),
    paste("F1_Score:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$F1_Score), "NA", best_row$F1_Score))
  ),
  best_summary_path
)
cat("Saved best model summary to:", best_summary_path, "\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# ROC curve comparison plot (if any ROC objects exist)
# ---------------------------
cat("=== ROC Curve Comparison ===\n")
roc_plot_models <- names(roc_objects)[sapply(roc_objects, function(x) !is.null(x))]
if (length(roc_plot_models) == 0) {
  cat("No ROC objects available to plot (missing probabilities or labels).\n")
} else {
  cols <- c("blue","red","green","purple","orange","brown","cyan")
  png_fname <- file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "model_comparison_roc.png")
  png(png_fname, width = 900, height = 700)
  first <- TRUE
  i <- 1
  legend_labels <- c()
  legend_cols <- c()
  for (mn in roc_plot_models) {
    roc_obj <- roc_objects[[mn]]
    if (is.null(roc_obj)) next
    if (first) {
      plot(roc_obj, col = cols[i], lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curve Comparison")
      first <- FALSE
    } else {
      lines(roc_obj, col = cols[i], lwd = 2)
    }
    legend_labels <- c(legend_labels, sprintf("%s (AUC=%.4f)", mn, as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))))
    legend_cols <- c(legend_cols, cols[i])
    i <- i + 1
    if (i > length(cols)) i <- 1
  }
  legend("bottomright", legend = legend_labels, col = legend_cols, lwd = 2)
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved ROC comparison to:", png_fname, "\n")
}

cat("\n=== STEP 8 COMPLETE ===\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")



```
